# `csharp_blank_lines_after_file_scoped_namespace_directive`

Blank lines after a file-scoped namespace declaration.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `1`

## Examples

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```editorconfig
csharp_blank_lines_after_file_scoped_namespace_directive = <value>
```
